title: About · Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs is a research organization working on applied AI. We build and run systems in production, publish notes on what we find, and develop products.

sections.heading: What we build and run
sections.text: Creosote Labs is a research organization working on applied AI: what these systems do once they are deployed into a working business. We build software and run it in production: operations systems, document tooling, teaching applications, and assessment-and-course engines for practitioners. We also develop products of our own, including Longtable and Scenario.

sections.heading: What we publish
sections.text: We publish notes on what we build and how it behaves in use, including the parts that did not work. They are on the [notes page](writing.html) and in the [RSS feed](feed.xml).

sections.heading: How to reach us
sections.text: Write to us through the [Work with us](work-with-us.html) page, or email [brian@brianburke.net](mailto:brian@brianburke.net).

leadership: The lab is led by a former chief operating officer of a venture-backed technology startup.
